standard.summary: 把部分模型层换到 CPU 内存以省显存。开启等价于把 blocks_to_swap 设成 2，关闭则设成 0。
standard.effect: 这是个布尔外壳：启动路径把它翻译成整数 blocks_to_swap 后就不再保留原键。已经填了 blocks_to_swap 时，开启不会覆盖更大的值；关闭则无条件清零。
standard.whenToUse: 显存差一点、又不想手动数 block 数时，用它开一个保守的交换量。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要精确控制换出层数时直接填 blocks_to_swap。追求速度时别开——每次换入换出都要走 PCIe。在 AMD ROCm 路线上它只是建议性提示，官方不建议叠加。

standard_en.summary: Offloads part of the model to CPU memory to save VRAM. Turning it on is equivalent to blocks_to_swap = 2; turning it off sets it to 0.
standard_en.effect: This is a boolean shell: the launch path translates it into an integer blocks_to_swap and does not keep the original key. When blocks_to_swap is already set, turning this on does not overwrite a larger value; turning it off zeroes it unconditionally.
standard_en.whenToUse: When VRAM is just short and you would rather not count blocks by hand -- it opens a conservative swap amount.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Set blocks_to_swap directly when you need an exact layer count. Skip it for speed -- every swap crosses PCIe. On AMD ROCm it is only an advisory hint and the guidance is not to stack it.

advanced.principle: TrainingRouteService.build_config_json 先 pop 掉 vram_swap，再按布尔值写 blocks_to_swap：真且原本没有值时写 2，假则写 0。因此下游只看见整数，config 里也没有 vram_swap 这个字段。
advanced.intervention: 请求归一化阶段的一次键转换，不进入训练循环。
advanced.expectedImpact: 换出 2 层通常省几百 MB 到 1 GB 级显存，代价是每步额外的传输开销。
advanced.tradeoffs: 「开 = 2」是写死的映射，与模型总层数无关；层数很多的模型上这个值偏保守，层数少的模型上又可能不够。

advanced_en.principle: TrainingRouteService.build_config_json pops vram_swap first, then writes blocks_to_swap from the boolean: 2 when true and nothing was set, 0 when false. Downstream only ever sees the integer, and vram_swap is not a config field at all.
advanced_en.intervention: One key conversion during request normalisation; it never reaches the training loop.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Swapping 2 layers typically saves hundreds of MB up to the 1 GB range, at the cost of extra transfer per step.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The on-equals-2 mapping is hard-coded and unrelated to the model's layer count: conservative for deep models, possibly too little for shallow ones.
